source.author: verg
source.text: Ego te, quae plurima fando enumerare vales, numquam, regina, negabo promeritam; nec me meminisse pigebit Elissae, dum memor ipse mei, dum spiritus hos regit artus.
source.text_original: 'Ego te, quae plurima fando / enumerare vales, numquam, regina, negabo / promeritam; nec me meminisse pigebit Elissae, / dum memor ipse mei, dum spiritus hos regit artus.
source.text_english: I shall never deny, queen, that you have well earned my gratitude, you who can recount so many things in speaking; nor shall I ever be ashamed to remember Elissa, so long as I myself remember myself, so long as breath rules these limbs.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Itaque dum spiritus hos artus regit, dum uitae huius fruimur commeatu , spondeo, promitto, polliceor: illam mea lingua resonabit, illi mei dedicabuntur labores, illi sudabit ingenium.
reuse.text_original: Itaque dum spiritus hos artus regit, dum uitae huius fruimur commeatu , spondeo, promitto, polliceor: illam mea lingua resonabit, illi mei dedicabuntur labores, illi sudabit ingenium.
reuse.text_english: Therefore, while the spirit rules these limbs, while we enjoy the sustenance of this life, I pledge, I promise, I assure: my tongue shall resound with that life; to it shall my labors be dedicated; for it shall my talent sweat.
